verses.html: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.text: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.title: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day.
verses.titleHtml: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day.

verses.html: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.text: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

verses.html: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.text: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

verses.html: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.text: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

verses.html: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.text: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.html: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.text: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

verses.html: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.text: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

verses.html: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
verses.text: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.

verses.html: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.text: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.html: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.text: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.html: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.text: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

verses.html: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.html: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.text: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.html: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

verses.html: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.text: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
